issues.problem: Hindi stoma/praise is स्तुति/स्तोम in the fixed renderings; "स्तोत्र" (a later genre term) disagrees with English "praise".
aṅgirasvat is "like the Aṅgirases"; "did" turns it into a clause not in the text.
Glossary spelling is अङ्गिरस्.
gotra is a different word from goṣṭha; English says cow-pens.
A neuter plural would be śuṣmāṇi; śuṣmā here is m. nom. pl. (śuṣmāḥ before y).
हरे means green; harya-aśva is tawny-horsed (English and gloss say tawny).
Glossary fixes brahman (n.) in Hindi as ब्रह्म.

The 1 is not clearly a typo: digits after a syllable are svara/pluti marks in this edition (cf. tanvī3, tanvo3 left unflagged in 2.16 and 2.17.7). The flag treats 1 as stray but 3 as fine; either drop the flag or flag both. The word split sadhryak / pṛthak is right.

issues.problem: English renders bhuvanā "beings", Hindi "worlds"; the two disagree (rodasī is separately "the two worlds"). Decide one rendering.
No augment: injunctive form, not an imperfect.
w "sā" is the feminine nominative form but is labelled m. nom. sg. "he". If sa+asmā is meant, w should be saḥ (as elsewhere); if feminine, the gloss is wrong. Needs a decision.
"known" (and Hindi "प्रकट") is an addition: kṛdhi praketam is "make a perception".
aviḍḍhi is "help" (English, gloss); रक्षा (protect) is stronger and differs from सहायता used for avas elsewhere.
Glossary fixes the refrain as "speak greatly in the rite".

Minor: brahman Hindi, गोष्ठ for gotra, stoma/stotra, śuṣmā gender, dṛṃhat tense, unit 3 text_flag on the digit 1 is doubtful, unit 4 bhuvana Hindi/English mismatch, unit 6 sā form.
